description:
## Goal

Implement the toolkit from `research/tool-authoring-toolkit-design`. Scenarios use it to declare tools in their `api/tools/` directory with minimal boilerplate and produce a valid protobuf `ToolManifest` for `/api/v1/tools`.

## Expected Work

- Implement the toolkit in the chosen package home (likely `packages/api-core` or similar).
- Provide builders/helpers that collapse a ToolDefinition declaration to the target line count.
- Provide the registration/aggregation pattern that composes individual tool files into the manifest response.
- Unit tests with a representative example tool.

## Acceptance

- One representative tool authored with the toolkit is objectively cleaner and shorter than the current hand-written pattern.
- Exposed via a stable Go API other scenarios can import.

## Out of Scope

- Migrating existing tools (separate item)
- Auditor rule (separate item)
- Skills or template (separate items)
name: tool-authoring-go-toolkit
title: Implement the shared Go toolkit for proto-tool authoring
